source: WTA official scores archive (wtatennis.com/tournaments/2092/ningbo/2025/scores/), wtatennis.com news recaps ('Zhu defeats ailing Raducanu in Ningbo; Yastremska powers past Mboko'), tennis-wta.com day-by-day results, Wikipedia 2025 Ningbo Open entrant-status list, ESPN digit-decoded scoreboard cross-verification. Bracket spine verified programmatically: every round's participants trace cleanly to the prior round's winners. 4 byes into R16 (top-4 seeds, all played, no withdrawals this edition): Andreeva, Alexandrova, Rybakina, Paolini. Reigning champion Daria Kasatkina withdrew before the tournament (personal reasons, per Wikipedia) and does not appear anywhere in this draw. Two corrections made during sourcing: (1) a pasted source's Yastremska-Mboko tiebreak claim of 7-6(1) was checked against WTA's own news recap and corrected to the confirmed 7-6(3); (2) Antonia Ruzic's apparent double-loss (once to Tomljanovic, once to Kudermetova) was resolved via Wikipedia's entrant-status list confirming Ruzic entered as a lucky loser from qualifying — her loss to Tomljanovic was a qualifying-round match, excluded from this main-draw-only dataset; only the Kudermetova result (6-3 6-2, main draw R32) is included here.
